defs.def: any or every; anything or everything 任何；每一；任何事物；一切事物

ex.s: The fun part of the activities is that the kids can eat or take home whatever they make.
ex.t: 活动的有趣之处在于，孩子们可以吃掉或带回家他们做的任何东西。

ex.s: If for whatever reasons, people’s errors become correlated or dependent, the accuracy of the estimate will go down.
ex.t: 如果由于某种原因，人们的错误变得相互关联或相互依赖，估算的准确性就会下降。

ex.s: Growing up in San Francisco, Grace Young used to watch her father shop daily in Chinatown for whatever he needed to make traditional Chinese meals at home.
ex.t: 在旧金山长大的格雷丝·杨，常常看着父亲每天在唐人街采购，为他要在家做的传统中餐准备所需的一切。

ex.s: My perfectionist tendencies were the main root of this: I wanted to be perfect at whatever I did, which obviously in life is not possible, but it consumed me.
ex.t: 我的完美主义倾向是主要原因：我想在所做的任何事情上都做到完美，这在生活中显然是不可能的，但它吞噬了我。

ex.s: Donate whatever clothes are left over
ex.t: G 告诉每个人带干净且状况良好的衣服

ex.s: I also water the flowers in the yard and tidying up my own bedroom whatever necessary.
ex.t: 我也给院里的花浇水，并整理自己的卧室，做任何必要的事。

ex.s: Exercising makes you more awake and ready to handle whatever is ahead of you for the day.
ex.t: 锻炼使你更加清醒，准备好应对当天面临的任何事情。

ex.s: That’s why this issue (期) of Writer’s Digest aims to help you figure out how to write the best ending for whatever kind of writing you’re doing.
ex.t: 所以本期《作家文摘》旨在帮助你弄清楚如何为你正在写的任何类型的作品写出最好的结局。

ex.s: Thinking that the man might get away with whatever he wanted before the police arrived, Kevin decided to do something.
ex.t: 想到那个人可能会在警察到达之前逃脱并得到他想要的任何东西，凯文决定采取行动。

ex.s: decide wisely what to eatD. eat whatever is offered
ex.t: 明智地决定吃什么 D. 吃提供的任何食物

ex.s: Filled with anger, you tend to say whatever comes to your mind.
ex.t: 充满愤怒，你倾向于说出你脑海中浮现的任何事情。

defs.def: （表示做什么或发生什么都没关系，因结果都一样）无论什么，不管什么

ex.s: He always participated to the best of his ability in whatever they were doing.
ex.t: 无论他们在做什么，他总是尽自己最大的能力参与。

ex.s: He always participated to the best of his ability in whatever they were doing.
ex.t: 无论他们在做什么，他总是尽自己最大的能力参与。

ex.s: Whatever grade the team received would be shared by both students.
ex.t: 无论团队得到什么成绩，两个学生都会共享。

ex.s: Whatever it is, the result is a fine and vivid description of the purest of Central Asian traditions.
ex.t: 无论它是什么，结果都是对最纯粹的中亚传统的一种精致而生动的描绘。

ex.s: Whatever you’re looking for
ex.t: 无论你在寻找什么

ex.s: Whatever our hobbies, the Internet can connect us with others who also enjoy doing them, even if they live on the other side of the world.
ex.t: 无论我们的爱好是什么，互联网都能让我们与那些也喜欢这些爱好的人建立联系，即使他们生活在世界的另一端。

ex.s: But Mom said that whatever happens, we should always try to see the good side of things.
ex.t: 但妈妈说，无论发生什么，我们都应尽量看到事物好的一面。

ex.s: Whatever it is, no matter how small it might seem, write it down.
ex.t: 不管是什么，不管它看起来多么微不足道，都把它写下来。

ex.s: Whatever the mistake, remember it isn’t a fixed aspect of your personality.
ex.t: 无论犯了什么错，记住它不是你性格中固定不变的一面。

ex.s: We figured that in twenty years each of us ought to have our destiny worked out and our fortunes made, whatever they were going to be.”“It sounds pretty interesting,” said the policeman.
ex.t: 我们想，二十年后，我们每个人都应该已经确定了自己的命运，并且发了财，不管结果会是什么。＂＂听起来挺有意思的，＂警察说。

defs.def: （用于问句，表示惊讶或困惑）到底是什么，究竟是什么
（用于回应，表示不在乎或不感兴趣）或许吧，无所谓
（表示不在乎，什么都可接受）什么都可以

ex.s: Whatever you decide, you can count on my complete support.
ex.t: 无论你决定什么，你都可以完全指望我的支持。

ex.s: He wasn't mean or abusive; he just gave me the impression he could do whatever project we dreamed up better if he did it alone.
ex.t: 他不是恶毒或虐待；他只是给我一个印象，他可以做我们梦想中更好的项目，如果他单独做的话。

defs.def: not at all; not of any kind 一点儿都（不）；丝毫（不）；什么都（没有）
